_doc: ADR 0026 v2 / M27 — real `sinatra-cors-1.2.0` gem vendored 1:1 under `vendor/sinatra/cors.rb`. Exercises the full CORS contract: allowed-origin filtering, allow-methods + allow-headers config, and the canonical `register Sinatra::Cors` install path. Same source on both runtimes (rubyrs vendored micro-Sinatra plus the gem source, CRuby installed Sinatra gem plus the same vendored cors.rb). The `keep_headers` manifest field (added in 32a4ea04) admits the CORS response headers into the diff transcript so the protocol effect is byte-diffable. The micro-Sinatra surface absorbed in this commit (after-filter, OPTIONS verb, route conditions via block-form `set`, `<key>?` predicates, `response`/`logger`/`process_route`/`routes_array`-vs-RoutesView) is shared with sinatra_hello + sinatra_plugin_smoke + sinatra_register_smoke + sinatra_jsonp_smoke so the upgrade benefits every Sinatra-shape fixture going forward.
name: sinatra_cors_smoke
